How Categories Work
Categories help you organize ticket types into groups.

The top-level folder is the category. Sub-folders are the ticket groups under that category.

Example Structure
📁 Beginner
├─ Men
├─ Singles
└─ Doubles
└─ Women
├─ Singles
└─ Doubles
📁 Intermediate
├─ Men
├─ Singles
└─ Doubles
└─ Women
├─ Singles
└─ Doubles
📁 Advanced
├─ Men
├─ Singles
└─ Doubles
└─ Women
├─ Singles
└─ Doubles

How It Generates
The first folder represents the main category.
Sub-folders create groups within that category.
Additional nested folders further refine the ticket structure.
Ticket types are generated from the complete hierarchy path.
